name: Account Created Then Added To Domain Group
description: A user account is created (4720) and a security-enabled global group then gains a member (4728) — the domain-level counterpart of the local-group rule, and the shape of a new account being put into a group such as Domain Admins. 4728 is written on the domain controller, so this rule matches DC logs; the two events are paired by host and time order, not by account.
